title: A Matter of Perspective(s): Contrasting Human and LLM Argumentation in Subjective Decision-Making on Subtle Sexism

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting human participants and multiple LLMs (GPT-3, GPT-3.5, GPT-4, and Llama 3.1) with real-world scenarios of subtle sexism, asking them to assess whether the scenario is sexist and provide a rationale, followed by qualitative coding and statistical comparison of the stances (e.g., sexist, not sexist, depends) and perspectives (victim, perpetrator, decision-maker) in their responses.
